Separated two-band projector, contraction with derivative bound and small tilt excludes extra nodes/pockets locally; compact gap excludes them elsewhere. T and Mz orbit forces common shifted energy. Threshold depends on fixed interior member.

Occupied-projector curvature is odd under onsite T, locally integrable at simple nodes; Mz gives zero gapped-slice Chern. Full projector avoids band-degeneracy ambiguity. Peierls Ward/contact are free finite-band results, not a quantum gauge phase.

T-square-one TRIM linear splitting has rank at most one; non-TRIM same-charge pairs and total zero flux imply four-node minimum only under stated band hypotheses. N1–N8 and N5 preserve live escapes and supplied-model scope.
